description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `retry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, attempts: number): Promise<T>`.

Poziva `fn` najviše `attempts` puta. Čim jedan poziv uspe, vraća njegov rezultat i više ne poziva `fn`. Ako svi pokušaji ne uspeju, odbija se **poslednjom** greškom.

Primer: `fn` baca grešku dva puta pa uspe; `retry(fn, 3)` vraća rezultat trećeg poziva.
description.en:
Write a function `retry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, attempts: number): Promise<T>`.

It calls `fn` at most `attempts` times. As soon as one call succeeds, it returns its result and does not call `fn` again. If all attempts fail, it rejects with the **last** error.

Example: `fn` throws twice and then succeeds; `retry(fn, 3)` returns the result of the third call.

text.sr:
Potpis asinhrone generičke funkcije.

- `async` znači da funkcija uvek vraća promise i da unutar nje sme `await` (čekanje rezultata).
- `function retry` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom.
- `<T>` je parametar tipa („promenljiva za tip“): tip rezultata određuje poziv. Ako `fn` vraća `Promise<string>`, i `retry` vraća `Promise<string>`.
- `fn: () => Promise<T>` je parametar `fn`: funkcija bez parametara koja vraća promise. Pozivamo je iznova, jer promise koji je već odbijen ne može da se „ponovi“.
- `attempts: number` je najveći broj pokušaja.
- `: Promise<T>` je tip rezultata.
- `{` otvara telo; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 11.
text.en:
The signature of an async generic function.

- `async` means the function always returns a promise and that `await` (waiting for a result) is allowed inside it.
- `function retry` creates a function with that name.
- `<T>` is a type parameter (a “variable for a type”): the call determines the result type. If `fn` returns `Promise<string>`, `retry` returns `Promise<string>` too.
- `fn: () => Promise<T>` is the parameter `fn`: a function with no parameters that returns a promise. We call it again and again, because a promise that was already rejected cannot be “repeated”.
- `attempts: number` is the maximum number of attempts.
- `: Promise<T>` is the result type.
- `{` opens the body; it is closed by `}` on line 11.

text.sr:
Pamtimo poslednju grešku.

- `let lastError` pravi promenljivu čija se vrednost menja kroz petlju.
- `: unknown` je najbezbedniji tip za nepoznatu vrednost: JavaScript može da baci bilo šta (`throw 5`), ne samo `Error`.
- Bez početne vrednosti, promenljiva je na početku `undefined`.
text.en:
We remember the last error.

- `let lastError` creates a variable whose value changes through the loop.
- `: unknown` is the safest type for an unknown value: JavaScript can throw anything (`throw 5`), not only an `Error`.
- Without an initial value, the variable is `undefined` at the start.

text.sr:
Petlja po pokušajima.

- Klasična `for` petlja ima tri dela: `let i = 0` (početak: brojač kreće od nule), `i < attempts` (uslov: nastavi dok je brojač manji od broja pokušaja), `i++` (korak: posle svakog prolaza brojač poraste za 1).
- `i++` znači „uvećaj `i` za 1“. Ovde je nebitno da li je prefiksno ili postfiksno, jer se vrednost izraza ne koristi.
- Telo se izvršava najviše `attempts` puta.
- Za `attempts = 0` petlja se ne izvršava nijednom, pa funkcija odmah baca `undefined` (granični slučaj).
- `{` otvara telo; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 9.

```
attempts = 3:  i = 0 → pokušaj 1
               i = 1 → pokušaj 2
               i = 2 → pokušaj 3
               i = 3 → 3 < 3 nije tačno, petlja se završava
```
text.en:
A loop over the attempts.

- A classic `for` loop has three parts: `let i = 0` (start: the counter begins at zero), `i < attempts` (condition: continue while the counter is less than the number of attempts), `i++` (step: after each pass the counter grows by 1).
- `i++` means “increase `i` by 1”. Here it does not matter whether it is prefix or postfix, because the value of the expression is not used.
- The body runs at most `attempts` times.
- For `attempts = 0` the loop does not run at all, so the function immediately throws `undefined` (an edge case).
- `{` opens the body; it is closed by `}` on line 9.

```
attempts = 3:  i = 0 → attempt 1
               i = 1 → attempt 2
               i = 2 → attempt 3
               i = 3 → 3 < 3 is not true, the loop ends
```

text.sr:
Početak zaštićenog dela.

- `try { ... } catch (...) { ... }` ide u paru: ako se unutar `try` desi greška (ili odbijen `await`), izvršavanje skače na `catch` u liniji 6, umesto da se funkcija prekine.
text.en:
The start of the protected part.

- `try { ... } catch (...) { ... }` goes as a pair: if an error occurs inside `try` (or an `await` is rejected), execution jumps to `catch` on line 6, instead of the function being aborted.

text.sr:
Pozivamo funkciju i čekamo rezultat.

- `fn()` poziva funkciju i dobija promise.
- `await` čeka da se promise završi i vraća njegovu vrednost. Ako je promise odbijen, `await` BACA grešku, što hvata `catch`.
- `return` izlazi iz cele funkcije `retry` i prekida petlju: kad jedan pokušaj uspe, više nema pokušaja.
- **Zašto `return await`, a ne samo `return fn()`:** bez `await` funkcija bi odmah vratila promise i napustila `try` pre nego što se promise završi. Odbijanje bi tada zaobišlo `catch` i ponovnog pokušaja ne bi bilo.

Tok za `fn` koji dva puta padne, pa uspe (`retry(fn, 5)`):

```
i = 0 → await fn() baca grešku → catch (linija 6)
i = 1 → await fn() baca grešku → catch (linija 6)
i = 2 → await fn() vraća 'done' → return 'done'   (petlja se prekida, fn pozvana 3 puta)
```
text.en:
We call the function and wait for the result.

- `fn()` calls the function and gets a promise.
- `await` waits for the promise to finish and returns its value. If the promise is rejected, `await` THROWS an error, which `catch` catches.
- `return` leaves the whole `retry` function and stops the loop: when one attempt succeeds, there are no more attempts.
- **Why `return await` and not just `return fn()`:** without `await` the function would return the promise immediately and leave `try` before the promise settles. The rejection would then bypass `catch` and there would be no retry.

Flow for an `fn` that fails twice and then succeeds (`retry(fn, 5)`):

```
i = 0 → await fn() throws an error → catch (line 6)
i = 1 → await fn() throws an error → catch (line 6)
i = 2 → await fn() returns 'done'   → return 'done'   (the loop stops, fn was called 3 times)
```

text.sr:
Hvatamo grešku.

- `catch (error)` se izvršava samo ako je u `try` nešto pošlo naopako. U `error` je ono što je bačeno.
- `error` je tipa `unknown` (ili `any`, zavisno od podešavanja kompajlera).
text.en:
We catch the error.

- `catch (error)` runs only if something went wrong in `try`. `error` holds what was thrown.
- `error` is of type `unknown` (or `any`, depending on compiler settings).

text.sr:
Pamtimo grešku i ne radimo ništa drugo.

- `lastError = error` upisuje grešku u promenljivu iz linije 2. Svaki novi neuspeh prepisuje prethodni, pa na kraju ostaje POSLEDNJA greška.
- Nema `break`, pa petlja prelazi na sledeći pokušaj.
text.en:
We remember the error and do nothing else.

- `lastError = error` stores the error in the variable from line 2. Every new failure overwrites the previous one, so in the end the LAST error remains.
- There is no `break`, so the loop moves on to the next attempt.

text.sr:
Zatvara `catch` blok.

- `}` zatvara blok otvoren u liniji 6.
text.en:
Closes the `catch` block.

- `}` closes the block opened on line 6.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo petlje otvoreno u liniji 3.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the loop body opened on line 3.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr:
Svi pokušaji su propali.

- Do ove linije se stiže samo ako nijedan pokušaj nije uspeo, jer uspešan izlazi preko `return` u liniji 5.
- `throw lastError` baca POSLEDNJU grešku (test traži `'fail 3'`, a ne prvu).
- U `async` funkciji `throw` znači da se vraćeni promise odbija tom greškom.
text.en:
All attempts failed.

- This line is reached only if no attempt succeeded, because a successful one leaves through `return` on line 5.
- `throw lastError` throws the LAST error (the test requires `'fail 3'`, not the first one).
- In an `async` function `throw` means the returned promise is rejected with that error.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: `return await` (a ne samo `return`) je bitan: bez `await` greška bi izašla iz funkcije pre nego što je `catch` stigne da je uhvati.
note.en: `return await` (not just `return`) matters: without `await` the error would leave the function before `catch` could handle it.
